module: Editor debug tool (menu Debug > "NamedTextureTarget Viewer") to preview render buffers (NamedTexTargets) with imgui: filterable list on the left, preview on the right with zoom/pan (wheel, drag), channel choice (RGBA, R, G, B) and view reset by double-click. Useful to inspect render targets, for example shadow maps.
notes: The list of available textures is refreshed when the window goes from hidden to visible.

onEditorGui.desc: Hook: draws the window (list + preview) and refreshes the target list on opening.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook: adds the Debug menu entry and registers the window (1100x700).
